title: Fully Online Decentralized Learning in Stochastic Games with Unknown Independent Chains
abstract: arXiv:2610.01181v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We consider stochastic games with independent controlled chains and unknown transition kernels, where players observe only their local states and realized payoffs. We develop a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that operates in the dual space of occupancy measures for approximating stationary Nash equilibrium (NE) policies. The algorithm uses a single transition/reward sample at every primitive time step, relies only on local information, and requires neither coverage of the joint state space nor synchronized episodes. Under uniform-ergodicity and finite-coverage assumptions, we show that, with high probability, the time-averaged fixed-comparator regret decays at the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ rate, up to logarithmic factors and polynomial dependence on the game parameters. In particular, the complexity depends on the cover times of the individual local state spaces rather than the product state space,

translated_title: 具有未知独立链的随机博弈中的完全在线去中心化学习
translated_abstract: 我们研究具有独立受控链和未知转移核的随机博弈，其中参与者只能观测到自身的局部状态和已实现的收益。我们提出了一种完全在线、去中心化且无需协调的镜像下降算法，该算法在占用测度的对偶空间中运行，用于近似平稳纳什均衡（NE）策略。该算法在每个基本时间步仅使用一次转移/奖励样本，仅依赖局部信息，既不需要覆盖联合状态空间，也不需要同步的回合。在均匀遍历性和有限覆盖假设下，我们证明，以高概率，时间平均的固定比较对手遗憾以标准的 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 速率衰减（直至对数因子以及与博弈参数的多项式依赖）。特别地，其复杂度取决于各个局部状态空间的覆盖时间，而非乘积状态空间的覆盖时间。
tldr: 该论文提出了一种完全在线、去中心化的镜像下降算法，在转移核未知且参与者仅观测局部信息的随机博弈中，以只依赖局部状态空间（而非联合状态空间）覆盖时间的复杂度近似平稳纳什均衡，并达到 $O(T^{-1/2})$ 的遗憾衰减速率。
en_tdlr: The paper develops a fully online, decentralized, and uncoordinated mirror-descent algorithm that approximates stationary Nash equilibria in stochastic games with unknown transition kernels and only local observations, achieving the canonical $O(T^{-1/2})$ regret rate with complexity depending on the cover times of local state spaces rather than the joint state space.
